articles.title: Musk’s SpaceX in Talks to Raise $40 Billion to Buy Nvidia Chips
articles.summary: Elon Musk’s SpaceX is in talks with banks and investors to raise $40 billion of debt to buy chips from Nvidia Corp., people familiar with the matter said, underscoring the insatiable demand among AI developers for more computing power.

articles.title: As China’s AI race accelerates, ‘model fatigue’ becomes the next challenge
articles.summary: On September 22, the global artificial intelligence landscape spun on its axis within a matter of hours. In Beijing, Xiaomi engineers went live with an unusual broadcast, streaming the training run of their new MiMo-V2.6 model. In San Francisco, Anthropic unveiled its frontier Opus 5.5 model. About an hour later, OpenAI crashed the party with the surprise release of its GPT-6 Sol and Luna models. articles.title: Nvidia-backed Reflection AI challenges Chinese dominance in open-weight models
articles.summary: An Nvidia-backed US start-up has unveiled an open-weight model to challenge China’s dominance in freely available artificial intelligence, releasing a system that early third-party testing suggests could be one of the most token-efficient open models in its class. Reflection AI on Monday debuted Beam, its first open-weight model built for coding, reasoning and agentic tasks.
